en: The report is not like witnessing
War is deception
A Muslim is a mirror of the Muslim
Someone whose advice is sought is in a position of trust
The person guiding (someone) to do a good deed, is like the one performing the good deed
Seek help for any needs discreetly
Protect yourself from the fire even with a part of a date

ar: الدُّنْيَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤمِنِ وَ جَنَّةُ الْكَافِرِ
en: The world is the believer’s prison and the disbeliever’s paradise
Modesty is entirely good
The word of the believer is like seizing of the hand

ar: لَا يَحِلُّ لِمُؤمِنٍ اَنْ يَّجُهْرَ أخَاهُ فَوقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أيَّامٍ
en: It is unlawful for a believer to sever relations with his brother for more than three days
He is not one of us who cheats us

ar: مَا قَلَّ وَكَفَى خَيْرٌ مِمَّا كَثُرَ وَأَلْهَى
en: A little that suffices is better than an abundance that distracts

ar: الرَّاجِعُ فِيْ هِبَتِهِ كَالرَّاجِعِ فِيْ قَيْئِهِ
en: Someone who takes back his gift is like someone who eats his vomit
Affliction comes from (loose) talk
People are like the teeth of a comb
Richness lies in the richness of the soul
The felicitous person takes lessons from (the actions of) others

ar: وَ إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ لَحِكْمَةً وَاِنَّ مِنَ الْبَيَانِ لَسِحْرًا
en: Indeed, in poetry there is wisdom and in eloquence there is magic
The king’s pardon preserves the kingdom
A man will be with whom he loves
A man who knows his worth will not be ruined
The child belongs to the bed and stoning is for the adulterer

ar: الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِّنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَي
en: The upper hand is superior to the lower hand

ar: لَا شَكَرَ اللهَ مَنْ لَّا يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ
en: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people
Your love of something can blind and deafen (you)

ar: جُبِلَتِ الْقُلُوبُ عَلي حُبَّ مَنْ اَحْسَنَ اِلَيْهَا وَ بُغْضِ مَنْ اَسَاءَ اِلَيْهَا
en: Hearts are predisposed to love someone who does them good and detest someone who does them harm

ar: الْتَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ كَمَنْ لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ
en: One who repents from sin is like someone without sin

ar: الشَّاهِدُ يَرَي مَا لَا يَرَاهُ الْغَائِبُ
en: The person who actually witnesses an (event) sees that which one who is absent does not
If the nobleman of a people comes to you, honour him
False oaths lay waste to home (lands)

ar: مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيْدٌ
en: Whoever is killed attempting to save his property is a martyr
Actions are through intentions
The leader of a people is their servant
The best of affairs is that which is balanced

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِيْ أُمَّتِيْ فِي بُكُوْرِهَا يَوْمَ الْخَمِيْسِ
en: O Allah, bless my nation in its early rising on Thursdays
Poverty can almost turn into disbelief
Travelling is a portion of punishment
The best of provision is God-Consciousness (taqwa)
Meetings are under trust
